description: 臺北市內湖垃圾焚化廠營運管理及環境品質監測報告 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府環境保護局內湖垃圾焚化廠. 涵蓋內湖垃圾焚化廠（以下簡稱本廠）營運操作之處理物進廠及產出物出廠統計：如垃圾進廠量、焚化量、底渣及飛灰產生量，以及進出本廠之清運車輛、廚餘進廠量等統計數據。. Coverage: 臺北市政府環境保護局內湖垃圾焚化廠. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府環境保護局內湖垃圾焚化廠. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
